newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.993 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.993 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended December 14th was 4,993,597 gallons compared with 4,870,788 gallons last week.
Imports were 1,835,242 gallons compared with 804,225 gallons the previous week. There were 28,540 domestic receipts this week compared with none the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,530,363 gallons , while bulk movement was 2,997,799 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 39,078,372 gallons.
